content: Always consult your healthcare professional for advice regarding your specific health needs and the use of this product. It is essential to seek complete information from your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use of any medication. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about potential side effects. Similarly, in Canada, reach out to your doctor for guidance on side effects. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. If the situation is less critical, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Instead, discard expired or unused products properly, following local disposal guidelines. The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific circumstances. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice from your healthcare professional. Always verify the most current and accurate information with your healthcare provider, especially regarding your health needs and the use of this product. For formulary information, create a list of plans to compare the status of this drug with others in the same class. This list can be saved and edited as needed. Note that individual plans may vary, and formulary details are subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the latest updates.
